title: PytestTriageFailures
description: Output of pytest-failure-triage Step 2 (parse failures), persisted at /tmp/triage/failures.json. Consumed by Step 4 RCA delegation to pytest-selenium-failure-analysis and by Step 5 ticket creation. Schema is forward-compatible: new optional fields may appear; consumers MUST ignore unknown fields.

schema_version.description: Bump only on breaking change. Add new optional fields without bumping.

run_label.description: CI build name/number, or YYYY-MM-DD date if unavailable. Used in JIRA summary and report filename.

path_or_url.description: Original path or URL of the report (for audit / re-parse).

run_totals.description: passed + failed + error + skipped should equal total; mismatch produces a warning entry.

warnings.description: Collection errors, count mismatches, files with no counted tests, missing owner mappings (filled in Step 3), etc.

nodeid.description: Full pytest nodeid: file::class::test or file::test. Stable identifier across runs.

test_file.description: File-only portion of nodeid. Key used by ownership.owner_map glob matching and JIRA dedupe.

error_type.description: Exception class name, e.g. TimeoutException, AssertionError, NoSuchElementException.

message.description: First line of failure message — short, used in JIRA summary table.

traceback.description: Full traceback. Fed verbatim to pytest-selenium-failure-analysis in Step 4.

duration.description: Seconds, if the report provides it.

artifacts.description: Paths to evidence the RCA skill needs. When parsing pytest-html or JUnit reports with attachments, fill these in.

owner.description: Filled by Step 3 (ownership resolution). 'unassigned' when no mapping found.

owner_source.description: Filled by Step 3. Records which resolution branch was taken — used in the final report for transparency.
